mx.name: Mexico
mx.note: States that en.wikipedia lists with a flag established by state law. Commons describes the files for Coahuila, Colima and Tamaulipas as fictitious or unofficial flags, and the current Tabasco drawing as used by the state government but not adopted by law. The other 17 states, and Mexico City, use only their coat of arms and have no official flag.

canvas.why: Jujuy's flag law (as Flags of the World translates it) gives the flag a length of 3:2 or 1:1 to its width, but this CC0 drawing is 711 by 804. The white field is continued on both sides to the square shape, which the earlier Commons versions of the file also had.

ar-y.later_versions: Hstoops' 2025 upload is a new drawing ("Uploaded own work"), not an edit of the earlier uploads by Cronholm144, HapHaxion and Lasunncty, which it replaced.

ca-mb.name: Manitoba
ca-mb.note: The circle draws the canton the way the repo's other Union Jack circles (au, nz, au-nsw) do: the center of the jack near the top left and its lower-right quarter enlarged into the top-left quadrant, the saltire running to the middle of the circle. The square fits the whole canton into the top-left quadrant like square/states/au-nsw, and both center the badge on the right half.
ca-mb.later_versions: Denelson83 rounded the dimensions and corrected a color (2006), Episteme added a DOCTYPE (2006), Superbenjamin corrected the shield (2015), Echando una mano redrew the bison (2015), Great Brightstar changed the colors (2019) and HapHaxion reduced the file size (2022).

ca-nt.name: Northwest Territories
ca-nt.note: Laid out like circle/countries/ca.svg: side bars from 0 to 144 and 368 to 512, with the shield centered on the white pale. Covers hide the seam where the copied shield region meets the white fill.
ca-nt.later_versions: Denelson83 made the white column a Canadian pale and corrected the colors (2006), Episteme added a DOCTYPE (2006), Connormah matched the colors to the territory's identity guide (2009), Zscout370 fixed the shield (2010) and Echando una mano redrew the fox (2018), before MapGrid's smaller version (2019).

ca-on.name: Ontario
ca-on.note: The circle draws the canton the way the repo's other Union Jack circles (au, nz, au-nsw) do: the center of the jack near the top left and its lower-right quarter enlarged into the top-left quadrant, the saltire running to the middle of the circle. The square fits the whole canton into the top-left quadrant like square/states/au-nsw, and both center the badge on the right half.
ca-on.later_versions: E Pluribus Anthony (2005), Episteme (2006), Zscout370 (colors from the province, 2007 and 2011), Bosonic dressing (2008), Fry1989 (colors and the Union Jack, 2010 and 2015), Superbenjamin (shield and leaves, 2015), Great Brightstar (colors, 2019) and HapHaxion (file size, 2022) revised the drawing.

canvas.why: The Provincial Flag Act makes the flag six feet in the fly and four feet in the hoist, fringe included (2:3). The Commons drawing was 1800 by 1200 until a 2024 upload removed a stray white strip at the hoist without restoring the width, which left it 1750.91 by 1199.99. The red chief and the white field are continued at the hoist, which has no fringe, back to 2:3.

clean.why: The Commons drawing shades four scrolls of the arms with small embedded JPEG patches, which become flat rectangles of their median color; at 1200 pixels that changes about 0.13% of the pixels, in patches of up to 330 pixels.

mx-gua.adaptation: show the arms on the white field without the gold frame around the flag

clean.why: The Commons drawing shades two thin bands of the arms with embedded JPEG strips, which become flat rectangles of their median color; at 1200 pixels that changes under 0.01% of the pixels, in patches of up to 35 pixels.
